summary: Added ProductSet rewriting to FiniteSet when all rewritten factors are finite sets, a ProductSet/FiniteSet subset dispatch using that explicit representation, and equality dispatch based on both subset directions. Regression tests cover the reported example, unequal tuple sets, symbolic uncertainty, infinite factors, nested products, and rewriting edge cases. Reproduced the original None subset result and Complement.equals AttributeError before editing. Public tests: test_sets.py 97 passed/4 expected failures; all sympy/sets/tests plus sympy/core/tests/test_relational.py 253 passed/8 expected failures, exit 0. Reviewed final diff.
